description: Correlates pod resource usage with its current host node. Resolves the node_exporter target separately from the Kubernetes node name. Pod device IOPS and PVC capacity are independent selections; no PVC-to-physical-disk mapping is assumed for LocalPV LVM.

panels.title: Section 1: Pod Resource and Host Pressure Overview

panels.description: Left: pod CPU cores and sum of configured container limits (not a complete pod limit if some containers are unlimited). Right: host CPU busy percentage, a utilization indicator, not proof of CPU saturation. See node iowait/steal below. Duplicate scrape series are collapsed per container before summing.
panels.title: Pod CPU Usage and Configured Limits | Host CPU Busy

panels.description: Pod working set and sum of configured memory limits on the left. Host memory unavailable % = 100 * (1 - MemAvailable/MemTotal) on the right; this is not node working set. A red time-based area appears only when that percentage exceeds 95%. It is a warning signal, not proof of an OOM or memory throttling. Missing telemetry remains missing.
panels.title: Pod Memory | Host Memory >95% Highlight

panels.description: Pod network bytes/s on the left. The red area is a binary host-network warning (0/1), not packet rate: any receive/transmit drop or error over the rate interval fills the graph height. Actual per-interface rates are in Section 2. Pod samples are collapsed per interface to avoid counting shared pod networking once per container; host-network pods may report shared host traffic.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(node_network_receive_drop_total{instance=~`${node_instance:regex}`, instance!="", job=~`${node_job:regex}`, device!="lo"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(node_network_transmit_drop_total{instance=~`${node_instance:regex}`, instance!="", job=~`${node_job:regex}`, device!="lo"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(node_network_receive_errs_total{instance=~`${node_instance:regex}`, instance!="", job=~`${node_job:regex}`, device!="lo"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum(rate(node_network_transmit_errs_total{instance=~`${node_instance:regex}`, instance!="", job=~`${node_job:regex}`, device!="lo"}[$__rate_interval]))) > bool 0

panels.title: Pod Network RX/TX | Host Drops or Errors Highlight

panels.description: Solid lines: pod read/write totals across devices reported for application containers. Dashed lines: selected pod_device only, in the same IOPS units. Right: selected PVC capacity used %, NOT disk busy %. Device selection is manual and independent of PVC selection; cAdvisor device labels alone do not prove PVC identity. Parent/POD cgroups are excluded, duplicate scrape series collapsed per container/device. Totals can still include multiple block layers if the runtime exports them and are not physical-disk totals. Empty IOPS means unavailable counters, not zero activity.

targets.expr: sum(max by (container, device) (rate(container_fs_reads_total{namespace=~`${namespace:regex}`, pod=~`${pod:regex}`, container!="", container!="POD", device!=""}[$__rate_interval])))
sum(max by (container, device) (rate(container_fs_writes_total{namespace=~`${namespace:regex}`, pod=~`${pod:regex}`, container!="", container!="POD", device!=""}[$__rate_interval])))

sum by (device) (max by (container, device) (rate(container_fs_reads_total{namespace=~`${namespace:regex}`, pod=~`${pod:regex}`, container!="", container!="POD", device=~`${pod_device:regex}`, device!=""}[$__rate_interval])))

sum by (device) (max by (container, device) (rate(container_fs_writes_total{namespace=~`${namespace:regex}`, pod=~`${pod:regex}`, container!="", container!="POD", device=~`${pod_device:regex}`, device!=""}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Pod IOPS: Total and Selected Device | PVC Capacity

panels.description: Selected node_exporter instance/job only. CPU busy includes non-idle modes including iowait. IOWait and steal are diagnostic signals, not additive to busy %. RAM unavailable % uses MemAvailable. CPU busy alone does not measure runnable-queue saturation; no missing series is replaced with zero.
panels.title: Host CPU, RAM, IOWait and Steal

panels.description: Per-device IOPS and busy time for the independently selected node devices. Busy % = rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total) * 100. It is not a reliable saturation ceiling for parallel NVMe/RAID devices. Logical and physical devices may represent the same I/O at different layers; they are never summed together here. No claim is made that these devices back the selected PVC.
panels.title: Host Device Read/Write IOPS and Busy %

panels.description: Per-interface receive/transmit drops and errors per second on the selected exporter target/job, excluding loopback. Includes virtual interfaces. Non-zero rates drive the red pod-network overlay; they indicate host-interface problems but do not prove the selected pod's packets were affected.
panels.title: Host Interface RX/TX Drops and Errors
Section 3: OpenEBS LocalPV LVM ($node | VG: $vg | PVC: $pvc)

panels.description: Measured node-exporter device-mapper operations matched to OpenEBS lvm_lv_total_size_bytes membership, following the upstream LVM dashboard approach. Solid: all reported non-thin-pool LVs in the automatically resolved VG. Dashed: the selected PVC's CSI logical volume only. Both exporters are scoped to the same node before matching devices; duplicate membership/scrapes are collapsed. These are logical-volume-layer IOPS, not physical-drive totals. Requires CSI volume-handle labels, scraped OpenEBS LV metrics and node-exporter counters for the matching dm devices. Missing matches remain gaps; partially exported devices produce partial VG totals.

targets.expr: sum(max by (device) (rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{instance=~`${node_instance:regex}`, instance!="", job=~`${node_job:regex}`, device=~"dm-[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (device) group by (device) (lvm_lv_total_size_bytes{instance=~`${lvm_instance:regex}`, instance!="", vg=~`${vg:regex}`, vg!="", device=~"dm-[0-9]+", segtype!="thin-pool"}))

sum(max by (device) (rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{instance=~`${node_instance:regex}`, instance!="", job=~`${node_job:regex}`, device=~"dm-[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (device) group by (device) (lvm_lv_total_size_bytes{instance=~`${lvm_instance:regex}`, instance!="", vg=~`${vg:regex}`, vg!="", device=~"dm-[0-9]+", segtype!="thin-pool"}))

sum(max by (device) (rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{instance=~`${node_instance:regex}`, instance!="", job=~`${node_job:regex}`, device=~"dm-[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (device) group by (device) (lvm_lv_total_size_bytes{instance=~`${lvm_instance:regex}`, instance!="", vg=~`${vg:regex}`, vg!="", name=~`${lvm_lv:regex}`, name!="", device=~"dm-[0-9]+", segtype!="thin-pool"}))

sum(max by (device) (rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{instance=~`${node_instance:regex}`, instance!="", job=~`${node_job:regex}`, device=~"dm-[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (device) group by (device) (lvm_lv_total_size_bytes{instance=~`${lvm_instance:regex}`, instance!="", vg=~`${vg:regex}`, vg!="", name=~`${lvm_lv:regex}`, name!="", device=~"dm-[0-9]+", segtype!="thin-pool"}))

panels.title: Volume Group IOPS vs Selected PVC ($vg)

panels.description: Read/write bytes per second summed across the reported non-thin-pool logical volumes in the selected PVC's VG. Uses OpenEBS LV membership and the same node-scoped device matching as the IOPS panel. Independent of the manual Pod I/O Device and Node Disk Devices selectors. This is logical-volume throughput, not backing-drive throughput; unavailable device counters are not replaced with zero.

targets.expr: sum(max by (device) (rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{instance=~`${node_instance:regex}`, instance!="", job=~`${node_job:regex}`, device=~"dm-[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (device) group by (device) (lvm_lv_total_size_bytes{instance=~`${lvm_instance:regex}`, instance!="", vg=~`${vg:regex}`, vg!="", device=~"dm-[0-9]+", segtype!="thin-pool"}))

sum(max by (device) (rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{instance=~`${node_instance:regex}`, instance!="", job=~`${node_job:regex}`, device=~"dm-[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (device) group by (device) (lvm_lv_total_size_bytes{instance=~`${lvm_instance:regex}`, instance!="", vg=~`${vg:regex}`, vg!="", device=~"dm-[0-9]+", segtype!="thin-pool"}))

panels.title: Volume Group Read/Write Throughput ($vg)

list.description: Node hosting the selected pod now. Historical samples are not remapped if a same-named pod moved nodes.
list.label: Host Node
list.name: node

list.definition: query_result(count by (instance) (node_uname_info{node=~`${node:regex}`, node!=""} or node_uname_info{nodename=~`${node:regex}`, nodename!=""} or node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", node=~`${node:regex}`, node!=""} or node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", instance=~`(${node:regex}|${node_ip:regex}|\[${node_ip:regex}\])(:[0-9]+)?`}))
list.description: Matches an explicit node label, uname nodename, or exact node-name/host-IP endpoint (optional port, including bracketed IPv6). Select one if multiple targets are discovered. An empty list means the scrape labels need inspection; it never falls back to all nodes.
list.label: Node Exporter Target
list.name: node_instance
list.query: query_result(count by (instance) (node_uname_info{node=~`${node:regex}`, node!=""} or node_uname_info{nodename=~`${node:regex}`, nodename!=""} or node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", node=~`${node:regex}`, node!=""} or node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", instance=~`(${node:regex}|${node_ip:regex}|\[${node_ip:regex}\])(:[0-9]+)?`}))

list.description: Select one scrape job to avoid adding duplicate node_exporter scrapes together.
list.label: Node Exporter Job
list.name: node_job

list.description: PVCs mounted by the selected pod. Controls capacity only until a verified PVC-to-LV/device mapping is available. Empty is normal for pods without PVCs.
list.label: PVC (capacity)
list.name: pvc

list.definition: query_result(count by (device) ({__name__=~"container_fs_(reads|writes)_total", namespace=~`${namespace:regex}`, pod=~`${pod:regex}`, container!="", container!="POD", device!=""}))
list.description: A device reported by cAdvisor for this pod, not an automatically resolved PVC. Select the PVC's logical device only after verifying the relationship. Changing PVC does not change this selection.
list.label: Pod I/O Device (manual)
list.name: pod_device
list.query: query_result(count by (device) ({__name__=~"container_fs_(reads|writes)_total", namespace=~`${namespace:regex}`, pod=~`${pod:regex}`, container!="", container!="POD", device!=""}))

list.description: Independent node-exporter devices, including logical devices if exported. All shows separate series, not a sum across physical disks and LVM layers.
list.label: Node Disk Devices
list.name: node_disk

list.description: OpenEBS LocalPV LVM uses the CSI volume handle as its logical-volume name. No PV-name or device-path guessing.
list.label: LVM Logical Volume (auto)
list.name: lvm_lv

list.definition: query_result(group by (instance) (lvm_lv_total_size_bytes{name=~`${lvm_lv:regex}`, name!="", node=~`${node:regex}`, node!="", instance!=""} or (group by (instance, namespace, pod) (lvm_lv_total_size_bytes{name=~`${lvm_lv:regex}`, name!="", namespace!="", pod!="", instance!=""}) and on (namespace, pod) group by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{node=~`${node:regex}`, node!=""})) or lvm_lv_total_size_bytes{name=~`${lvm_lv:regex}`, name!="", instance=~`(${node:regex}|${node_ip:regex}|\[${node_ip:regex}\])(:[0-9]+)?`, instance!=""}))
list.description: Finds the selected LV's exporter on the pod's node through a node label, exporter pod placement, or an exact node-name/host-IP endpoint. The LVM creation-host label is not used as node identity.
list.label: LVM Exporter (auto)
list.name: lvm_instance
list.query: query_result(group by (instance) (lvm_lv_total_size_bytes{name=~`${lvm_lv:regex}`, name!="", node=~`${node:regex}`, node!="", instance!=""} or (group by (instance, namespace, pod) (lvm_lv_total_size_bytes{name=~`${lvm_lv:regex}`, name!="", namespace!="", pod!="", instance!=""}) and on (namespace, pod) group by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_info{node=~`${node:regex}`, node!=""})) or lvm_lv_total_size_bytes{name=~`${lvm_lv:regex}`, name!="", instance=~`(${node:regex}|${node_ip:regex}|\[${node_ip:regex}\])(:[0-9]+)?`, instance!=""}))

list.definition: query_result(group by (vg) (lvm_lv_total_size_bytes{instance=~`${lvm_instance:regex}`, instance!="", name=~`${lvm_lv:regex}`, name!="", vg!=""}))
list.description: Automatically follows PVC -> PV -> CSI volume handle -> OpenEBS LV -> VG on the selected node. Empty means the required KSM/LVM metadata is unavailable or the PVC is not LocalPV LVM. No fallback to unrelated VGs.
list.label: Volume Group (PVC auto)
list.name: vg
list.query: query_result(group by (vg) (lvm_lv_total_size_bytes{instance=~`${lvm_instance:regex}`, instance!="", name=~`${lvm_lv:regex}`, name!="", vg!=""}))
